app.notes:
A brand-new look from the home page to Settings, with a 3D microphone made for every theme
A bar along the bottom, or down the side on a TV, takes you to Home, Songs, My Songs, Profile, and Settings in one tap
A redesigned keypad with easier Key, Tempo, and Melody controls and a big Play button
Tapping a song in the stage search now asks whether to sing it now or reserve it, and reserving no longer starts it, so you can line up several first
Every song list has a Sing button, and the top three scores now stand on a podium
Settings are grouped into categories, and the search still finds any setting
Mic-Key now runs full screen. Turn it off in Settings, Behavior, Full Screen
VIP is free for everyone: send your Device ID to get a code. Donating is optional
